name: rusticlone
postCreateCommand: rustup component add rust-analyzer clippy rustfmt && curl -L --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall/main/install-from-binstall-release.sh | bash && cargo binstall --no-confirm --disable-strategies compile cargo-nextest cargo-insta cargo-deny "rustic-rs@$(cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps | jq -r '.metadata.rustic.version | ltrimstr("v")')"
